items.title: City login protocol compatibility
items.description: Tracing client/server handshake and release compatibility locally.
items.note: Protocol 14 fallback implemented; 20 city tests and packaging passed. Network regression tests compile but socket execution is sandbox-blocked; awaiting controller verification and review.

items.title: Metric history charts
items.description: Implementing population, company and government time-series views locally.
items.note: Rebase conflict resolved in worktree; master milestones and rendering-review requirements retained. Combined tree passed 25 chart, demolition and isometric-camera tests. Eight fresh Linux Mesa OpenGL captures show changing metrics across four domains at 1280x720 and 640x640. Evidence: metric-trends-rebase-verification.json and metric-trends-rendering.json. Controller stages and continues rebase; independent review pending.

items.title: Building demolition
items.description: Implementing authoritative demolition and inspector controls.
items.note: Implementation ready for independent review. Demolition and related city regression tests passed; full verification encountered only sandbox socket errors. Evidence saved locally; no publication or deployment performed.

items.title: Special building permits and placement
items.description: Implementing catalog, ownership, levels, and authoritative placement checks.
items.note: Replay conflicts resolved; metric feature and milestone retained, overhead protection and civic demolition preserved. All 23 combined tests passed again; menu/placement OpenGL evidence retained. Ready for controller staging and rebase continuation. Evidence: special-buildings-metric-replay-tests.json.

items.title: Isometric camera rotation
items.description: Implementing quarter-turn camera controls and rotation-aware panning; preparing camera and picking regressions.
items.note: Implementation ready for separate review. Rebindable left/right quarter turns preserve isometric pitch, focus and zoom; panning follows orientation. Targeted verify passed 15 tests and packaged all jars. Full suite: 161 passed, 10 socket-permission errors, zero assertion failures. Evidence: dashboard/evidence/isometric-rotation-tests.json. No graphical display for F10 recording.

items.title: Development dashboard
items.description: A mobile-friendly progress view, historical work and linked test evidence.
items.note: Published the mobile-friendly dashboard with 13 historical items, testing evidence, refresh/offline fallback and a milestone updater that skips game rebuilds.

items.title: Voxel One website and documentation
items.description: An engaging game landing page and easy-to-navigate feature documentation.
items.note: Published the game landing page and nine detailed, navigable documentation sections. Passed 16 WebKit/Chromium phone and desktop checks.

items.title: Sun and daylight
items.description: A visible sun with directional lighting.
items.note: Sun and HDR sky, filtered geometry shadows, verified in both AA paths. Playtest 13 passed all four desktop builds and is deployed on the VPS.

items.title: Global illumination
items.description: Indirect light and occlusion for the voxel world.
items.note: Background voxel skylight, diffuse sunlight bounce and occluded RGB light propagation implemented. Sealed-room, mixing and falloff regressions pass; irradiance upload verified in the renderer.

items.title: Environment lighting and reflections
items.description: Sky illumination and material reflections.
items.note: Daylight environment cubemap lights surfaces and supplies roughness-dependent sky reflections. Real GPU comparisons verify reflected light affects surfaces.

items.title: Anti-aliasing and texture filtering
items.description: Reduce jagged edges and improve sampling quality.
items.note: 4x MSAA on accelerated drivers, FXAA fallback, filtered procedural textures, mipmaps and supported anisotropy. Both paths, texture parameters, resize and no-GL-error checks passed.

items.title: Coloured glowing blocks
items.description: Place LED-like blocks with any chosen colour and visible local illumination.
items.note: Craftable LED lights with any 24-bit RGB colour, F8 picker, full/fractional placement, coloured indirect light, held-item replication and persistent multiplayer RGB edits. All 74 tests pass; live jayms login and Windows auto-update verified.

items.title: Player physics and multiplayer
items.description: Walking, jumping, collision and a shared, persistent server world.
items.note: Implemented, verified and published.

items.title: Accounts, controls and flight
items.description: Authenticated TLS sessions, editable controls, flight, smooth movement and holographic player names.
items.note: Implemented, verified and published.

items.title: Inventory, health and procedural worlds
items.description: Nine hotbar slots, 36 inventory slots, pickups, health, caves, trees and four seeded biomes.
items.note: Implemented, verified and published.

items.title: Isometric sky camera
items.description: Orthographic world overview with zoom and a return to the player camera.
items.note: Implemented, verified and published.

items.title: Tiny voxel models and flower pots
items.description: Sparse octree models, procedural generators, custom items and model persistence in multiplayer.
items.note: Implemented, verified and published.

items.title: Three player camera views
items.description: F5 cycles behind the player, in front, and back to first person, with camera obstruction checks.
items.note: Implemented, verified and published.

items.title: Player rig, held items and desktop updates
items.description: Classic voxel proportions, walking animation, visible first-person arm and held items, plus automatic desktop updates.
items.note: Implemented, verified and published.

items.title: Held model placement
items.description: Held voxel models remain fully in front of the first-person hand.
items.note: Implemented, verified and published.

items.title: Swing, jumping, names and skin fixes
items.description: Downward attack, gentler placement, repeat jumping, inventory name tooltips and a non-flickering outer hair layer.
items.note: Implemented, verified and published.

items.title: Terrain to the horizon
items.description: Adaptive background terrain reaches 2,048 blocks in each direction; the isometric view fits the 4,096-block visible footprint.
items.note: Implemented, verified and published.

items.title: Octree world and smaller blocks
items.description: World chunks use sparse octrees; half, quarter, eighth and sixteenth cubes support precise collision, picking and saved edits.
items.note: Implemented, verified and published.

items.title: Direct 3D voxel modelling
items.description: Build, paint, erase and pick colours directly in 3D, with orbit, brush sizes, hex colours and undo/redo.
items.note: Implemented, verified and published.

items.title: Inventory crafting
items.description: 86 recipes consume inputs across the inventory, stack outputs and drop overflow. Multiplayer validates recipes on the server.
items.note: Implemented, verified and published.

items.title: Voxel City One: playable city simulation
items.description: Building configurable time, ECS populations, polygon zoning, generated structures, road travel and rideable horses.
items.note: Released Playtest 14 on all four desktop platforms and deployed separate City and sandbox servers. Convex zoning, generated buildings, population economy, horses, day/night and ECS implemented. 87 tests passed; GPU/client, updater, TLS login and saved-world checks passed.

items.title: Dashboard questions and persistent answers
items.description: Adding mobile answer forms and private persistent storage; future development questions will use the dashboard.
items.note: Published persistent private questions and editable answers. Passed 12 WebKit/Chromium/API checks; verified live D1 tables and authenticated agent question creation. All future questions use this dashboard.

items.title: Mayor budget and private developers
items.description: Separating public city spending from private plot purchases, construction, companies and property sales/rent.
items.note: Released Playtest 15 and deployed both VPS servers. Mayor treasury pays for roads; private companies buy plots, employ construction workers, fund buildings and sell/rent property to businesses and households. 94 tests, all four platform builds, actual client Economy/property panels, Windows updater and live TLS/save upgrade checks passed.

items.title: FPS counter
items.description: Adding a readable half-second FPS average to the player HUD.
items.note: Added a top-right FPS counter, averaged over actual elapsed time and refreshed every half second. Visible during gameplay, isometric view, the model editor and menus. Packaged-client GUI checks passed; Playtest 16 passed 94 tests on all four platforms and the Windows updater downloaded and verified the release.

items.title: Nameplates for actual players only
items.description: Removing population/NPC holographic nameplates while keeping actual player labels and citizen inspection.
items.note: Removed population/NPC holographic labels; actual local and multiplayer player labels remain. Citizen identities are available through Inspect. Packaged-client city/first-person/third-person checks passed. Playtest 17 passed 94 tests on all four desktop platforms; Windows updater download and checksum verification passed.

items.title: Mayor population dashboard
items.description: Building a dedicated live city dashboard with population wellbeing, housing, jobs, socioeconomic groups and public/private finances.
items.note: Released in Playtest 18: F9 or Dashboard opens Overview, Groups, Citizens and Finances. Live housing, jobs, hunger, savings and budget metrics; searchable citizen roster locates people in Inspect. All 103 tests passed on four desktop platforms, seven packaged-client checks and eight documentation browser checks passed, and the Windows updater downloaded and verified the release.

items.title: City time and daily population routines
items.description: Reviewing the existing city clock and routines; implementing visible daily life and verifying multiple simulated days.
items.note: Released Playtest 19 and updated the VPS city with a backup and preserved clock/population/finances. Added midnight calendar rollover, daily routines and work/meal/sleep gestures, hourly hunger/pay rates and safe building aisles. Three full days passed: all 12 citizens worked, ate, travelled and slept each cycle; 72 hourly samples recorded. All 109 tests passed on four platforms, GPU/client/browser checks passed, Windows update verified, and live pinned-TLS city snapshots advanced.

items.title: In-game screen recorder and video evidence
items.description: Implementing MP4 game capture, a recording control and inline dashboard video evidence.
items.note: F10 records the game, HUD and menus to a silent MP4; controls are editable, resizing preserves aspect ratio and normal Quit finishes saving. The inline dashboard video is an actual 14.6-second city run. All four desktop builds passed 117 tests; 8 WebKit/Chromium browser checks, 5 video handler tests and 2 built-worker route checks passed. Playtest 20 is published and the Windows updater downloaded and verified its recorder and encoder. GUI tests ran on Linux/Mesa; no physical Windows or iPhone playtest.

items.title: Operating businesses and mayor business dashboard
items.description: Expanding shops and mines into staffed businesses with operating accounts, production, sales and a mayor monitoring screen.
items.note: Operating shops and mines now have staffed shifts, inventory and delivery flows, sales, wages, rent and persistent daily accounts. F9 > Businesses monitors locations and private companies, with filters, search, staffing/stock/financial alerts and seven completed days of history. Three simulated days and 72 hourly samples reconcile cash and stock. Playtest 22 passed 129 tests on all four desktop platforms; 8 WebKit/Chromium checks and both authenticated VPS connections passed. Existing city and accounts are preserved. The recorded walkthrough captures the business implementation before the final vacant-location label correction. Windows updater verified; GUI testing used Linux/Mesa, not a physical Windows desktop.

items.title: Natural materials and building information
items.description: Adding resource harvesting businesses, privately owned material stocks, developer construction requirements and clickable building details.
items.note: Playtest 24 is committed, published and deployed on both VPS servers. Verified 142 tests on each desktop platform, three simulated days with conserved natural materials, recorded building inspection, Safari-compatible evidence playback, Windows auto-updating and live test-account TLS sign-in. Existing city, accounts and TLS identity retained with backups.

items.title: Road addresses and configurable manufacturing
items.description: Persistent road names and numbered building addresses, configurable private factory recipes, and purchased tools that improve mining and logging productivity.
items.note: Committed and pushed 84bbfcb; Playtest 25 published and both VPS services upgraded with existing worlds/accounts preserved. 152 tests passed on all four platforms, three city days conserved supplies and cash with 34 tools produced and all 12 citizens fed/sleeping; actual client video, mobile browser checks, Windows updater, and both live TLS logins verified. Zone additional industrial land to obtain factory premises in the existing city.

items.title: Farmer-owned agriculture and food supply chains
items.description: Adding agricultural zones, farmer-funded construction and expansion, wheat/carrot/sugarcane crops, cattle, and privately traded food manufacturing.
items.note: Playtest 27 committed, pushed and deployed to both VPS services. Agricultural crop/cattle farms are privately built and expanded by farming families; developers stay out. Wheat/carrot/cane fields and finite fed cows supply bread/flour/sugar/carrot-cake factories and markets. 160 tests pass on Windows/Linux/Mac Intel/Mac ARM; three-day world conserves building materials and cash, with 18 citizens eating/sleeping and paid farm expansion. Real F10 walkthrough and Safari-style video checks attached. Windows updater downloaded the final client; existing jayms login, TLS, city clock, properties, accounts and public budget verified. Existing city needs new agricultural land and industrial factory plots.

items.title: Solid voxel light occlusion
items.description: Tracing propagation and surface sampling; testing opaque walls against glass, air and fine voxels.
items.note: Playtest 28 committed, published and deployed. Actual opaque octree leaves block skylight, sunlight, reflected sky and RGB LEDs; glass and air transmit. All 166 tests pass on Windows, Linux and both Macs. GPU hidden-light and sunlight tests change zero pixels across a solid 1/16 wall. Windows updater verified; both VPS worlds, accounts and TLS preserved.
